name: Cenomi Centers (Arabian Centres Company)
note: Listed on the Saudi Exchange (Tadawul). Per the 2025 annual report: immediate parent FAS Real Estate Company Limited (26.89% of capital at 31 December 2025, the largest stake in the substantial-shareholdings table; the next holder holds 4.00%) and ultimate parent Saudi FAS Holding Company; the report's financial statements identify Salman Abdulaziz Alhokair and Fawaz Abdulaziz Alhokair as the group's controlling shareholders, and Fawaz Abdulaziz Al Hokair chairs both Arabian Centres Company (Cenomi Centers) and Saudi FAS Holding Company (2025 annual report, board biographies).
